b.x: The hypothesis, with the right name

There is a serious proposal, and it is not a video. Roger Penrose holds that consciousness does not fit in a computer that only calculates. For him there is a physical process, objective reduction: the quantum superposition does not last forever. It resolves, and in that resolving there would be a trace of experience. Stuart Hameroff proposed the place: the microtubules, tiny structures inside the neuron. Together they called this orchestrated objective reduction. In plain words: biology would organize very small quantum states, and the collapse of those states would be part of what it is to be aware. This is a hypothesis. It is not consensus. It is not law. There are researchers looking for quantum effects in those structures. There are others saying the brain is too warm, too wet, and too noisy for that to last. Both sentences fit on the same page. Whoever has already arrived at consciousness does not need the microtubule to sign underneath. Whoever has not arrived does not arrive by memorizing the two names.

At the very small, a particle is not a little ball with a fixed address before measurement. There is a range of what can be said. That is called superposition: it is not 'it is in both places like a ghost at your service'. It is: the description has not yet chosen one result. When there is a real measurement, the range closes into one result. Interference, that sum of possibilities that leaves a mark, disappears if the path gets marked. This has been seen. It is physics. What has not been seen is a man wishing, with no instrument at all, changing the result because his mind wanted it. Measurement, in this branch, is an interaction that leaves a record. A detector. An environment that marks the path. It is not your cheering. Calling cheering observation is swapping the word so you can feel like the cause of what you did not measure.
The error that dresses the person

There is an old, minority reading that puts consciousness as what closes the range. It exists in books. It has not won the laboratory. The spiritual market took that reading and removed the care. It became this: you look, therefore you create; you feel, therefore the universe obeys; if it did not obey, your vibration failed. That is not study. It is guilt with a new vocabulary. The gray man does not wear that coat. It does two bad things. It inflates the I, which starts to think itself the operator of the cosmos. And it crushes the person when the fact does not change, because the sentence says the fault is her degree. Quantum physics did not sign this. What signs it is the wish to have a shortcut. A shortcut is not expansion. Expansion is seeing the shortcut sentence as a sentence.

The argument against the hypothesis is simple to say. A delicate quantum state comes apart when it talks to the environment. That is called decoherence. In the brain, the talk is constant: heat, water, ions, noise. Calculations made in that model show the coming-apart too fast for a quantum 'computation' to explain a thought that lasts a second. The reply of those who defend the hypothesis is that the model looked in the wrong place, and that inside the microtubule there would be shelter. The shelter has not been proved as the explanation of consciousness. It has not been buried either. Honest study lives in that middle. You may say: it is possible that the very small takes part in the living. You may not say: therefore my thought is a superposition the universe is waiting to obey. The first sentence is open science. The second is fantasy with the first in its pocket.

Take the word quantum away. What remains is still high. You are aware of this sentence. That awareness was not given by any instrument and no instrument has removed it. The thought appears in it. You are not the thought. Attention chooses what will be fed in the next seconds. What you feed organizes what you are able to see. That is already a cause. It does not need a particle to be true. The analogy, if it is used, has to come with the name of analogy. At the very small, the range closes when there is a record. In life, the range of the sentence closes when you act or when you believe. While you see the sentence without becoming it, both degrees are still available: the old one and the slightly wider one. This looks like superposition. It is not. It is the freedom not to identify. The gray man uses that freedom. He does not announce that he is in superposition. He does not promote the sentence to fact without one proof in the room. And he does not promote a wish to a physical law.
How the gray man studies this

He studies so as not to be fooled by the word, including the pretty word. If someone says quantum physics proved his sentence, he asks for the experiment, not the enthusiasm. If the experiment is not there, the sentence goes back to being a sentence. That is the same craft of not promoting a rumor to fact. The universe at the very small is stranger than the everyday story. Admitting the strangeness is humility. Using the strangeness to feel above whoever does not know the word is the narrow degree in a new coat. Quantum consciousness, at the highest point this page will hold, is only this: do not lie about what physics measured, and do not lie about what you are. You are what is aware. The rest is hypothesis, analogy, or hunger. The hypothesis may one day win. Hunger does not become proof while it waits. And consciousness does not stand in the hall waiting for the laboratory to authorize what it already is.
